claim: Grandview C-4 selected as Cohort 1 participant in Real World Learning initiative forming South KC micro-region with Center and Hickman Mills
District establishes partnership with Kansas City National Security Campus (Honeywell) to create advanced manufacturing pathway at Grandview High School
District adopts 5-year Comprehensive School Improvement Plan (2022-2027) organized around Success-Ready Students and Workforce Excellence
Board formally reviews and approves evaluation of district Real-World Learning program assessing college prep placement career center enrollment MVA attainment and STEM participation
Administration presents 2024 MSIP 6 APR results showing overall score of 127.5/200 points (63.7%) with 86.6% continuous improvement points earned
District expands shared Real World Learning pathways across graphic design barbering cosmetology welding healthcare and advanced manufacturing with regional partners
Board appoints Dr. Stephanie Amaya as Superintendent effective July 2026; Amaya explicitly identifies Real World Learning as strategic leadership focus
Board receives update on continuation of T&L Welding partnership providing 200 hours of coursework leading to 100% AWS student credential attainment
Board approves preliminary operating budget for 2026-2027 fiscal year and updates Career Ladder incentive allocations
